display.purpose: Alex's name, flagship names and case titles.

body.purpose: Readable product, case and experience prose up to 68ch.

label.purpose: Normal-case evidence captions, dates and controls.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Controls, theme and language state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action in a section, including the scoped case CTA.

components.name: Case Cover
components.description: Compact cobalt title surface inside the 68rem reading shell. It is related to the home stage but never duplicates its hero content.
components.css: .ds-case-cover{min-height:clamp(16rem,30vw,22rem);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:20px;padding:clamp(32px,6vw,64px);border-radius:3px;background:#2f6ba8;color:#fff}.ds-case-cover h1{margin:0;color:#fff;font:600 clamp(52px,8vw,96px)/.92 Anek Latin,sans-serif}.ds-case-cover p{max-width:48rem;margin:0;color:#e4eff9;font:400 18px/1.45 Anek Latin,sans-serif}

components.name: Evidence Frame
components.description: One 16:10 exterior frame for every case. Only a naturally matching source fills it; panoramic and square evidence remain complete on matte.

components.name: Decision Grid
components.description: A semantic ordered list with open two-column desktop reading and no visual ordinal.
components.css: .ds-decisions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:48px}.ds-decisions li::before{content:none}.ds-decisions h3{font:600 18px/1.3 Anek Latin,sans-serif}.ds-decisions p{font:400 16px/1.65 Anek Latin,sans-serif}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-decisions{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

components.name: Results Band
components.description: One tonal band for selectable values and labels, not a collection of cards.
components.css: .ds-results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:24px;padding:40px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface-sel)}.ds-results strong{display:block;font:600 32px/1 Anek Latin,sans-serif}.ds-results span{font:400 14px/1.45 Anek Latin,sans-serif}

components.name: Social Mark
components.description: A one-ink A and period on an opaque cobalt square. It remains legible at 16px and supplies the 180px apple icon.
components.html: <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" role="img" aria-label="Alex Micó Robles"><rect width="64" height="64" fill="#2f6ba8"/><path d="M12 49 27.2 14h7.6L50 49h-8.7l-3-7.6H23.6L20.7 49H12Zm14.3-14.6h9.4L31 22.5l-4.7 11.9Z" fill="#f7fbff"/><rect x="51" y="42" width="6" height="7" fill="#f7fbff"/></svg>

narrative.overview: A committed cobalt identity where Alex, Strev and Sereno are remembered together. The home uses a full stage; each case uses a compact cover followed by neutral evidence-led reading.
keyCharacteristics: Alex, Strev and Sereno appear at the same moment of recognition.
Anek Latin supplies one clear interface voice.
Cobalt is a large field of identity, not a scattered decorative accent.
Case content remains semantic, static and inspectable.
Real evidence uses one 16:10 exterior frame without cropping data.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt as a committed identity surface, never as repeated card decoration.

rules.name: The Stage and Cover Rule
rules.body: The home may fill the viewport; a case cover stays compact and contains only title plus tagline.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Real Rule
rules.body: Real screenshots remain complete and carry a visible caption.

rules.name: The Structure Survives Rule
rules.body: Semantic order, visible scope and selectable results survive visual simplification.

rules.name: The Reachable Closing Rule
rules.body: Back, case links, CTA and Contact keep a 44px minimum target.

dos: Show Strev and Sereno at equal weight.
Use a compact cobalt cover to connect cases to the home.
Use Anek Latin and real product evidence.
Keep case content static and readable in both themes.
donts: Do not duplicate the hero inside a case.
Do not crop evidence to force its interior ratio.
Do not use ornamental ordinals, pill links, card walls or universal hairlines.
Do not present internal Anuubis operations as Alex's public identity.
